avis.texte: Makes your skin unbelievably smooth. I got my Elemis kit on NLC cruize and have been happy using since 2024
I love this! I used to use the rose exfoliator, but it was discontinued. When I reached out to Elemis, they suggested this one. It is great. It's not harsh, it's very gentle.
I love this exfoliator. It's the perfect consistency and works so well.

After an in-store demo, I was excited for this splurge purchase and the possibilities of dewey soft skin, great smells, and a luxury experience. Unfortunately that was not my reality. Don't get me wrong, it has great exfoliation! But the product separated into 2 textures and experiences! A milky thin watery liquid seeped out of the tube and would at times swirl around a thick yellow exfoliating gel like substance with an off-putting aroma. I don't want to lay it down or put the flat end down and risk what remains of the milky substance leak out. Neither shaking like Shakira or massaging the tube would bring the substances together though. Maybe an aged or a quality issue with my tube, but I don't think I'll pony up again to try it, at this price point. I had high hopes based on the initial in-store experience, but was let down unfortunately with the reality.
I love the way this exfoliates my skin. It smells clean and refreshing. Makes my skin glow.
This exfoliator is effective without being harsh. I use it almost every day. I love how it smells and how soft it leaves my skin. I highly recommend this product!
I finally can exfoliate without drying out my skin. Love the smell, texture, and hydration.

I purchased this during the 21 days of beauty event for 50% off. The exfoliation is very gentle and I didn't feel that super fresh faced after typically exfoliation. I'd prefer something like the exfolikate or having a little more grit. Price is a bit high
I have very dry and sensitive skin, and this exfoliator does not irritate it at all.

A friend of mine recently purchased from a spa so of course I was interested in trying. Needless to say, I've started using it 3 times a week as stated in the directions. My skin looks so radiant and hydrated. I feel like I have a fresh facial after each use. It provides a healthy glow. I want to use this product everday! I came here to purchase this product for myself. I will continue to use this product from here on out, plus some of their other products!

The fine granules gently scrub your skin and make it so smooth. I love the texture of the scrub. The granules are fine but there are a lot of them in each drop so you only need a little to scrub your whole face.
This is a good exfoliator but I have used better ones especially the ine by Zo but I will still use this one when I can't get Zo.

I'm obsessed with this formula, it's not too harsh as it melts into my skin while taking the dead skin off with it! I adore the process and of course my Elemis routine after! Always a great product for us all!
I ise Elemis apricot toner daily. After the dark, drab winter months I decided to try this exfoliator. It works very well without drying out my sensitive skin.
I love this exfoliator. It has a pleasant smell and works wonderfully. My skin absolutely glows after I use it!
Left my face smooth and glowing. One of my favorite new products.
Love everything I've tried from Elemis, this was no exception. Great products that my skin loves.
This is the best exfoliator I have used! The granules are fine and rinse away easily leaving my skin much smoother.
My skin feels smooth. I like the scent, and leaves my skin glowing.
This is a perfect exfoliator! It exfoliates without causing your skin to feel "sandpapered" and leaves your skin feeling clean and soft and it smells divine! Being from Elemis, it is top quality.

This has been my favorite of the jelly exfoliators and I've tried all three. My skin feels the smoothest after using it. I'm not a huge fan of the scent but it's subtle enough not to be bothersome to my allergies.
This exfoliator is truly the best. Vwey gentle on my skin but removes dirt and buikd up on my mature skin. I recommend it to anyone as it leaves your face feeling fresh and smooth.

avis.titre: This exfoliator is a game changer!!
avis.texte: I'm blown away by this exfoliator! It is so gentle yet SO EFFECTIVE. Your face feels amazing afterwards, polished yet very hydrated and not stripped like other exfoliators I've used. I can definitely see a reduction in the size of my pores after using, and my makeup goes on much better, and lasts longer. This product is a game changer in my book, and probably now one of my top two "must haves" from Elemis. Love love love.....

This is a wonderful exfoliator for someone with sensitive skin. I've used the rose exfoliator for many years but always felt I needed a little more "scrub". This product is the answer. It's gentle but effective to making my skin look and feel wonderful. I love the fact that the product has the smell and feel of the cleansing balm with a little kick to it!
